name: mellos-mapping
description: 梅勒斯地图 — a live layered dependency map for bottom-up development: ghost the design first, then light nodes up from the bottom as they are built and verified

interface.shortDescription: Live plans beside your ChatGPT desktop Codex conversation
interface.longDescription: For ChatGPT desktop in Codex mode (Codex App). Automatically open a live mmap terminal in the current conversation's right browser panel, with semantic zoom, node selection, child maps and independent font size. The installer includes every browser/runtime dependency and registers eight local MCP tools. Native terminal, SVG web maps and Markdown remain available.
defaultPrompt: 用梅勒斯地图制定当前任务的分层计划，用 web-terminal 自动在当前对话右侧打开并持续展示，不需要我粘贴命令。
先声明本次功能的设计图，在右侧持续展示实现和验证进度。
